tasks.Cool Off: Encouraging the individual to calm down after expressing anger violently.
tasks.Fight: Promoting a physical altercation as a solution for releasing anger.
tasks.Illustrate Point: Encouraging the individual to express their point verbally or through actions without violence.
tasks.Punch: Allowing the individual to physically release their anger by punching something.
tasks.Release Energy: Suggesting activities that allow the individual to channel their energy in a non-violent manner.
